sites.reason: ADR 0123 (#4670): Adapter of the Elternabrechnung onto the letter contract of Document Rendering; it translates a combination without letters into ErrBillingLettersMissing.
ADR 0119 (#4668): lists the billing runs of the session's Träger after refusing a missing Träger; the Träger transaction is the caller's.
ADR 0115 (#4664): refuses an empty key and a link without Träger or period before the public contribution opens the Träger transaction; the administrative transaction is the caller's.
ADR 0115 (#4664): checks the Träger and validates the rule as a whole (kind, parameters, validity) before the store inserts it; the Träger transaction is the caller's.
ADR 0115 (#4664): checks the Träger and the rule ID before the store removes the rule; a frozen contribution keeps what it froze.
ADR 0115 (#4664): lists the holiday rules of the session's Träger after refusing a missing Träger; the Träger transaction is the caller's.
ADR 0115 (#4664): checks the Träger and the rule ID and validates the rule as a whole before the store changes it; a frozen contribution keeps what it froze.
